text:
Alex (sales): Hey team — Sundial Health wants to run a short POC next week. They have a custom model 'sundial-40b-med' (HF repo + custom tokenizer). Ask: can we add it to catalog for a hosted POC or do they need Dedicated/Private? Also pricing + KMS/QoS requirements.

Tara (solutions): Thanks Alex — quick clarifying q's: 1) do they need HIPAA-level controls (PHI)? 2) expected QPS and latency SLO (p50/p95)? 3) do they insist on a quantized variant or need FP16 fidelity for clinical accuracy?

Alex (sales): They said yes to HIPAA (so KMS + audit logs). QPS small (1–3 rps), latency target p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms. They asked about cost-estimates for q4_0 vs fp16.

Liam (ml-eng): Quick note — custom tokenizer can be a pain if tokenizer vocab differs from RLHF checkpoints. Need either the tokenizer JSON + merges or a converted tokenizer to our runtime. Also want model weights in HF format (safetensors preferred). Do we have a quant conversion path for sundial architecture?

Ivy (infra): For HIPAA + KMS we recommend Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed keys. Hosted can work if they sign BAAs and allow our managed KMS, but Private is cleaner.

Tara (solutions): @Liam do we have an internal compatibility checklist we can run quickly? If yes we can tell sales what to send and estimate onboarding ETA.

Liam (ml-eng): Yes — checklist (short):
1) weights: safetensors or pt -> HF layout
2) tokenizer files (tokenizer.json / vocab / merges)
3) config.json with hidden_size/ffn_dim/num_heads/rotary args
4) a 512-token sample inference test script (we run perf + correctness)

Ivy (infra): Also need sample prompts and an eval set (5–10 clinical Qs) to check regressions.

Alex (sales): I'll ask Sundial to upload to a private HF repo or S3 with a short README. They can redact PHI in sample prompts.

Claire (product): For cataloging: if variant required (q4_0 vs fp16) we should record: variant name, quantization method, expected token throughput, memory footprint, and fallback policy. Product needs that to expose in console.

Tara (solutions): Pricing: rough host POC numbers — with q4_0 we can usually run on 1x A10-type instance for low QPS; fp16 needs 1x A100-ish for reasonable latency. Ballpark per-token delta: q4_0 ~ 0.75x hosted price vs fp16. I'll handwave until we run perf.

Liam (ml-eng): Operational blocker: KV cache format — some custom models use nonstandard kv ordering, which breaks our continuous batching. If their model uses a custom attention impl, we may need a small adapter or to run as a legacy transformer path (slower). Ask them: did they change attention patterns or add custom ops?

Alex (sales): Good call. I'll ask the PM. Also they pinged about security questionnaire — legal asked for certs + a standard SOC2 excerpt. Who handles that?

Ivy (infra): Security packets = security@redwood. We can attach SOC2 summary + HIPAA controls doc. For KMS integration, we need tenant KMS endpoint + key policy details (Customer-managed keys require Private or Dedicated).

Tara (solutions): Next steps (actions):
- Alex: collect HF/S3 link, tokenizer, config, sample prompts, eval set, and security POC contact (today).
- Liam: run compatibility checklist + small perf run once artifacts available (48h turn).
- Ivy: draft recommended infra (Hosted with BAA + managed KMS vs Dedicated/Private) and rough cost delta (24h).
- Claire: prepare catalog fields template for new variant (so we can show in demo).

Alex (sales): Assigned and noted. Sundial aiming for POC kickoff Mon. If we need more time we'll push.

deploy-bot: new-deployment-request received for thread 1733333333 — placeholder ticket #POC-8921 created.

Liam (ml-eng): One more technical note: if they want function-calling + streaming, ensure the tokenizer preserves special tokens for tools. Otherwise streaming chunking will be off. Ask them to include a tokenization demo: encode('') and counts for a couple example prompts.

Tara (solutions): Nice — I'll add that to the artifact list.

Alex (sales): Thanks all — I'll ping when upload link is live. :thumbsup:
